title: East vs. Garfield — Football (2025–2026)
summary: East Dragons vs. Garfield Rams — 2025–2026 high school football coverage in Akron, Ohio. Photography by Mason Bybee.
article_headline: East vs. Garfield: City Football Through the Lens
article_dek: The Dragons and Rams captured in a local football gallery.
article_body:
East and Garfield bring two Akron programs together for a matchup rooted in local high school football. Beyond the score, the story includes the players taking the field and the atmosphere surrounding them.

This gallery documents the competition through original photography by Mason Bybee. The photographs are preserved without attributing an unverified score or individual statistics.
